Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time; after the 16:00 ET close, the next trading day). Dollar figures in thousands as the filings print them ('_k'; from Q1 2010 the releases, 10-Qs and 10-Ks print millions, stored times 1,000); per-share figures as published (no split to the end of 2013).
